global.note: Crusader Defence - manifest 14: SWAROG na nowo (12 assetow, 3 poziomy bazowe + 3 galezie x 3 tiery). POWOD: w grze Swarog przestal strzelac pociskami - jest MIOTACZEM OGNIA, leje ciagly strumien w kazdego wroga w zasiegu. Stare sprite'y (katapulta ognia) klamaly o jego dzialaniu. Nowa sylwetka: KUZNIA Z DYSZA - zelazna paszcza bestii, z ktorej bucha nieprzerwana struga plomienia. PIEC KLATEK TO WYMOG (jak reszta wiez): 1-3 idle (miech oddycha, wegle rozzarzaja sie), 4 = wind-up (miech sie zatrzaskuje, gardziel dyszy bieleje), 5 = release - GRUBY CIAGLY JEZOR OGNIA W PRAWO od krawedzi do krawedzi klatki, NIE kula ognia (silnik odbija klatke w lewo, gdy cel jest po lewej). Strip poziomy 5 klatek 384x512 (calosc 1920x512), plik <id>.png. Tlo przezroczyste na #00FF00 -> rembg. Qwen-Image nie obsluguje negative prompt - pole negative ZAWSZE ' '. Wszystkie 12 sprite'ow tym samym seedem.

assets.prompt: CAMERA LOCK: three-quarter top-down game view - the camera is raised about 45 degrees above the subject, looking down at it from the front-right like a classic isometric strategy game; the subject's TOP surfaces and FRONT side are both clearly visible at the same time, a ground ellipse sits beneath it, no horizon, no sky, never a straight-on front view, never a worm's-eye view, never a flat overhead map view. The exact same camera in every frame and every asset of this set. FIVE FRAMES IS A MUST: a horizontal sprite sheet strip of EXACTLY 5 equal frames in one row, filling the image edge to edge, no gaps, no borders, no numbers, no labels. Not 4, not 6 - EXACTLY 5. EVERY frame shows THE SAME shrine from the identical camera angle, at the identical position and identical scale. The shrine of SWAROG, the Slavic god of fire and the forge: a squat pagan forge-shrine of blackened oak and hammered iron, an anvil at its heart, a bellows of stitched hide at its flank, a bed of glowing coals in its belly, and above all a heavy IRON NOZZLE shaped like a snarling beast's maw jutting forward as the mouth from which the fire pours. Carved sun-wheels and hammer marks cover the wood. Level 1: small and rough - a single-bellows field forge, a short iron nozzle, a modest coal bed, unpainted timber, no ornament beyond a single carved sun-wheel. The five frames are five precisely defined states of a FLAMETHROWER shrine - a forge that pours an unbroken jet of fire, never a catapult and never a projectile launcher. FRAME 1 (idle A): the forge at rest, the nozzle dark, only embers glowing deep in the coal bed, the bellows relaxed. FRAME 2 (idle B): the same forge, the bellows drawn open and swelling with air, the coals brightening to orange, a thin curl of smoke rising from the nozzle. FRAME 3 (idle C): the same forge, the coals white-hot, a small pilot flame licking out of the nozzle mouth - frames 1-2-3 form a smooth breathing idle loop. FRAME 4 (flame wind-up): the bellows slam shut, the whole forge shakes, the nozzle throat glows white and a short burst of fire coughs from its mouth - pressure building, not yet released. FRAME 5 (flame release): a THICK CONTINUOUS JET of roaring fire pours from the nozzle to the RIGHT, edge of frame to edge of frame, a sustained stream and not a fireball - the flame is a solid unbroken tongue with a white core, orange body and dark smoke curling off its top, the forge rocked back by the recoil, sparks streaming. The engine mirrors this frame, so the jet must exit cleanly to the RIGHT. Style: painterly semi-realistic fantasy game art, rich textured brushstrokes, dramatic lighting driven by the fire itself, pagan Slavic smith-god iconography (blackened oak beams, hammered iron, forge coals, carved sun-wheels, chains, anvil), deep earthy palette with molten orange and white-hot highlights, heroic mythic atmosphere, readable silhouette at small size on a mobile screen. Transparent background on #00FF00, clean cut-out, no ground plane, no scenery.
